regime_context: Detector shows broad but non-dominant rotation (frac 0.57, one_narrative false, absorption 0.33) with Memory/HBM leading on a mean-reverting, crowded, zero-breadth profile. Gate discipline is validated on this history (gate_helps true), but the leader's mean-revert tag and zero breadth argue against trend persistence.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the memory_storage leader's zero breadth persists into the next read while silver_miners or gold_miners breadth stays above 0.7 — if memory breadth prints >0.4 on a fresh read, the avoid read retires and the leader re-enters as a genuine trend candidate.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 2 with a score (1.85) that is a full tier above the rest of the eligible field except the leader, broad breadth (0.75), non-crowded (z 0.53), and mixed-to-trending Hurst. In a mean-reverting leader with zero breadth, the durable non-crowded challenger with breadth is the most defensible trend candidate. Supported by rank+breadth+crowding legs; not by rotation timing (which is display-only).
evidence: rank 2, score 1.85 vs challenger field ~1.2 and below
theses.dissent: Silver miners are reflexively tied to silver spot; a dollar-strength/spike in real yields deflates SIL regardless of equity breadth, and the mixed Hurst tag suggests the trend is not cleanly established.

falsifier.text: SIL loses every cent of its 20-day advance on a single risk-off tape before the check-by date, with breadth collapsing below 0.4 on the detector's next read.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The leader's profile argues against chasing: mean-revert Hurst, breadth 0.0 (single-name concentration), crowded (z 1.44), r10 0.087 into a quiet val_state. A top-ranked crowded narrative with zero breadth and mean-reversion is a fade-from-the-standpoint-of-new-risk, not a buy. This is NOT a short or fade call — it is an avoid because reflexivity on the way down punishes new longs and crowding cautions sizing, not direction.
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM cycle fundamentals are real — HBM pricing and capacity are trough-tight and this could re-accelerate despite the weak technical texture; avoiding could miss the single strongest 2026 leadership.

falsifier.text: SMH closes above its prior 10-day high and breadth on the Memory theme expands above 0.5 on the next detector read before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: The most durable and cohesive trend in the field: trend Hurst, breadth 0.917 (near-unanimous constituent participation), non-crowded (z 0.22), durability_bar 0.73 (highest in the dataset). In a regime where the top narrative is mean-reverting and zero-breadth, a high-breadth precios metals trend is the cleanest trend-following expression the gate would permit. Supported by trend-gate + breadth + durability legs.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have high beta to gold spot; if the geopolitical premium in macro flow (unscheduled_share 0.98) unwinds on a de-escalation headline, GDX gives back its relative leadership quickly and trend-Hurst does not protect against a narrative-priced shock.

falsifier.text: GDX breaks below its 50-day moving average while Gold Miners breadth drops below 0.6 on the next detector read before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
